hero.title: Excellence in Education
hero.subtitle: Providing a holistic, rigorous, and technologically advanced academic curriculum under WBBSE & WBCHSE.

secondary.title: Secondary Section (Class V - X)
secondary.desc: Affiliated with the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education (WBBSE). Emphasizes core foundations in Language, Mathematics, Physical & Life Sciences, History, and Geography.

higherSecondary.title: Higher Secondary (Class XI - XII)
higherSecondary.desc: Affiliated with the West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education (WBCHSE). Offering specialized academic streams for engineering, medical, commerce, and civil services careers.
higherSecondary.point2: WBCHSE Higher Secondary Final Board Exams

resources.heading: Academic Resources
resources.intro: Download official curriculum guidelines, question patterns, and syllabus PDFs approved by WBBSE & WBCHSE.

departments.heading: Our Academic Departments
departments.subheading: Specialized streams designed for comprehensive higher secondary and competitive preparation.

science.name: Science & Technology
science.desc: Dedicated state-of-the-art labs for Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Computer Science with hands-on experimental coursework.

humanities.name: Arts & Humanities
humanities.desc: Deep analytical and historical studies in Bengali, English Literature, History, Geography, Philosophy, and Political Science.

commerce.name: Commerce & Business
commerce.desc: Comprehensive modern coursework in Accountancy, Business Studies, Commercial Law, and Economics preparing students for corporate finance.

calendar.heading: Academic Calendar 2024-25
calendar.subheading: Key institutional dates and milestone timeline
calendar.downloadAlert: Full academic calendar PDF download initiated.

unitTest.title: Unit Test - I Commencement
unitTest.desc: Applies to Class V through X. Detailed room allocations posted on official notice board.

summerBreak.title: Summer Vacation Break
summerBreak.desc: School closes for summer break. Reopens on June 18th for all sections.

labSubmission.title: H.S. Lab Project Submissions
labSubmission.desc: Final deadline for submitting Class XII Practical Lab Records & Computer Projects.

preBoard.title: Pre-Board Mock Examinations
preBoard.desc: Madhyamik and Higher Secondary Test examination series commences.

exams.codeDesc: A minimum of 75% annual attendance is mandatory under WBBSE/WBCHSE norms to appear for final board examinations.
exams.resultsDesc: Access unit evaluations, terminal report cards, and board result rankings using your Student Roll & DOB.

facultyBanner.title: Meet Our Distinguished Faculty
facultyBanner.desc: Our qualified team of senior postgraduate teachers (PGTs) and trained graduate teachers (TGTs) bring decades of mentoring excellence to every classroom.
